desc:
⚔️ Kit PVP: Block Style PvP!

🗡 KITS: Sword, Axe, Crystals, Mace, Trident and more! - Pick your kit or make your own and fight your way.

🏆 DUELS: 1v1 / 2v2 / Ranked / Casual / Minigames.  - Win fights and climb the leaderboard.

🌍 FREE FOR ALL: Drop into the arena anytime and fight whoever you find.

🗺 ARENAS: 15+ Maps to fight on, from Desert to Nether.

📊 STATS: Your wins, kills and rating save between sessions.

📱 Works on PC, mobile and controller.

⭐️ Shows us your love by liking and favoriting the game!
